questions.text: What type of tasks can Amazon Bedrock agents automate?
questions.explanationHtml:
Correct

Customer support interactions

  • Amazon Bedrock Agents are ideally suited for automating complex customer support interactions. This involves tasks such as:

    • Orchestration: Breaking down a natural language request (e.g., “I need to check my order status and change my shipping address”) into multiple sequential steps.

    • API Execution: Automatically calling back-end company APIs (defined via Action Groups and executed by AWS Lambda) to check the order status, verify the user’s identity, and execute the address change in a CRM or fulfillment system.

    • Knowledge Retrieval: Using a Knowledge Base for Amazon Bedrock to answer policy-related questions (e.g., return window, shipping costs) with up-to-date information.

    • This is a prime example of automating a multi-step, repetitive business process that requires transactional interaction with company systems.

Incorrect

Financial reporting

  • While an agent could be programmed to fetch data, the complex analysis, data visualization, and synthesis required for comprehensive financial reporting are typically handled by dedicated Business Intelligence (BI) tools like Amazon QuickSight or specialized financial modeling software. Bedrock Agents are primarily task orchestrators, not deep analytical engines, unless the analytical steps are simplified into distinct API calls or code execution.

Code deployment

  • Code deployment is a task strictly managed by DevOps and MLOps tools such as AWS CodePipeline, AWS CodeDeploy, or Amazon SageMaker MLOps. These services ensure version control, security checks, and rollbacks. While an agent could list deployment status, it is not designed to replace these mature, mission-critical infrastructure orchestration and CI/CD pipelines.

Infrastructure management

  • Infrastructure management (like spinning up EC2 instances, managing S3 buckets, or configuring networking) is typically done using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools like AWS CloudFormation or Terraform. These tools provide the necessary immutability and state management. Although Bedrock Agents can be used to perform simple, ad-hoc IT operations based on natural language commands (e.g., “List my EC2 instances”), their core purpose and most common business application are the transactional automation of customer-facing and internal business processes, not complex, governed infrastructure provisioning.

questions.text: What is a common use of natural language processing (NLP)?
questions.explanationHtml:
Correct

Speech recognition

  • Correct because NLP is widely used in speech recognition systems.
  • It enables machines to convert spoken language into text and then process the meaning.
  • Examples include Amazon Alexa, Google Assistant, and speech‑to‑text transcription services.
  • This is a core application of NLP in real‑world AI systems.

Incorrect

Image classification

  • Incorrect because image classification falls under computer vision, not NLP.
  • NLP deals with text and language, while image classification deals with visual data.

Predictive maintenance

  • Incorrect because predictive maintenance uses machine learning models on sensor data and operational logs.
  • It is not related to language processing.

Anomaly detection

  • Incorrect because anomaly detection is a data analytics technique used to identify unusual patterns in datasets.
  • It is not a direct application of NLP.
